meta.name: xget
meta.description: Use when tasks involve Xget URL rewriting, registry/package/container/API acceleration, integrating Xget into Git, download tools, package managers, container builds, AI SDKs, CI/CD, deployment, self-hosting, or adapting commands and config from the live README `Use Cases` section into files, environments, shells, or base URLs.

copy.tagline: 加速下载、容器构建和包管理中的网络请求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要加速访问海外资源或镜像
copy.tagline_en: Accelerate network requests in downloads, container builds, and package management
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to accelerate access to overseas resources or mirrors

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能自动将下载、Git、包管理器、容器构建、AI SDK 等命令中的 URL 重写为 Xget 加速地址，并直接执行配置或文件修改。
howto.when: 当你要求配置、设置、添加、迁移或部署 Xget 加速，或提到“用 Xget”时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Xget 加速 pip 安装
say.note: Claude 会修改 pip 配置使用 Xget 镜像

say.text: 把 Docker 拉取改为 Xget 代理

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically rewrite URLs in commands for downloads, Git, package managers, container builds, and AI SDKs to use Xget acceleration, and directly execute configuration or file edits.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to configure, set up, add, migrate, or deploy Xget acceleration, or mention "use Xget".

say_en.text: Help me accelerate pip install with Xget
say_en.note: Claude will modify pip config to use Xget mirror

say_en.text: Make Docker pulls go through Xget proxy
say_en.note: Claude will configure Docker daemon for Xget acceleration
